Class Divider

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.Divider
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class Divider extends AbstractPanelElement
A line between sections of a panel: a solid fill, no texture, no input. 
Divider.horizontal().at(0, y).build();                 // fills the panel's width
Divider.horizontal().at(0, y).size(160, 1).build();    // 160 px long
Divider.vertical().at(x, 0).size(1, 40).build();       // 40 px tall

Filling (§0066)

A horizontal divider given no size fills whatever width its panel or container gives it, every layout pass, and asks for none itself, so it never widens the panel: the section rule of a settings body, as wide as the body whatever the window's size. A vertical divider needs a size.

With a size, a horizontal divider is (length, thickness) and is capped to its panel's width; a vertical one is (thickness, length).
